messages:
elaine: Heads up — please don't merge PR #9081 yet. It's gated on the new routing RFC. RFC link: https://redwood.company/rfcs/908-routing-tiling (see section 3 for shard affinity).
ravi: Reposting: merge held. CI is green except the canary smoke that flaps.
sophi: I pushed a small fix for the test flakiness in the PR (force-push). Unit + e2e now pass locally.
arch-team: Can you paste a 2-line summary of the architecture change and SLO impact? Also need a link to the RFC anchor to reference in the PR.
elaine: Summary: add an ordering layer to routing to prefer local shard leaders -> reduces cross-AZ KV lookups by ~30%. SLO delta: p50 unchanged, p95 ~+3ms worst-case during rebalancing. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% over 2 hours. RFC: https://redwood.company/rfcs/908-routing-tiling#leader-affinity
arch-team: Thanks. We're short on bandwidth; pinging @ravi for perf numbers. If the SLO delta is <=5ms we'll probably ok with canary. Please add the RFC anchor to the PR description and call out rollback steps.
ravi: @arch-team ran perf job earlier, attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/ravi/ff33a. p95 delta median 2.8ms on our canary traces.
sophi: Added RFC link + rollback instructions to PR description. Also added a short runbook entry.
merge-bot: merge queue: PR #9081 marked 'hold: awaiting arch review' by @elaine
elaine: :thumbsup: thanks — ping me if you need more details. I'll wait for arch ack before removing hold.
